clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf guides night elves arriving from Shadowglen. As a resident of Teldrassil, she speaks for the Council of the Forest and directs them to local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's boughs.

Syral Bladeleaf helps direct new arrivals through Dolanaar beneath Teldrassil's canopy. She speaks for the Council of the Forest, sending night elves to community leaders and herbalists in the village and nearby wilderness. Her guidance leads travelers to Denalan, a botanist at Lake Al'Ameth, and helps them replenish supplies for the village elders.

In Dolanaar, Syral carries out the Council of the Forest's work for the village. She helps see that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that disruptions to the local ecosystem receive swift attention.
